title: Triple-synergy bactericidal action: a mannose-decorated bioinspired coating on silver-mesoporous silica for eradicating multidrug-resistant Mycobacterium tuberculosis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,46266-46276
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07047C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yiyan Song, Dawei Yu, Zhijie Sheng, Huafeng Song, Junchi Xu, Jianping Zhang, Hui Chen, Ping Xu
An integrated triple anti-tuberculosis nanoplatform was developed, leveraging a synergistic combination of silver nanoparticles, EPL, and a Schiff-base structure to effectively eliminate drug-resistant Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
